title: aira littoralis
intro: Aira littoralis, commonly known as sea bent, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Aira littoralis include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe wounds, reduce swelling, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Aira littoralis include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
